price_note: Prices are a starting point. Your final price depends on your design, whether your colour is in stock, and how far I travel — I'll always confirm it on WhatsApp before your appointment.

price_factors.title: Your design
price_factors.body: A single colour is quickest. French tips, chrome, 3D art and hand-painted detail take more time and product, so they cost a bit more.

price_factors.title: Your colour
price_factors.body: If I have your colour in my kit, great. If I need to buy a specific shade just for your set, I may add the cost of it.

price_factors.title: Travel distance
price_factors.body: I come to you. Areas close to me have no or a small travel fee; further areas cost a little more. See the travel table below.
